metadata.methods_description: Data were collected using BioSemi ActiveTwo 64-channel EEG and SR Research EyeLink 1000 Plus eye-tracking during a naturalistic reading task with retrospective self-report (ReMind task) for mind-wandering annotation. Participants read standardized articles while EEG and eye-tracking data were simultaneously recorded and synchronized.

citation_details.title: ROAMM: A Benchmark Dataset for Multimodal Human Attention Decoding and EEG-to-Text Modeling During Naturalistic Reading
citation_details.author: Niharika Singh, David Jangraw, Ardyn Olszko, Haorui Sun
citation_details.abstract: Note that OSF has a 50 GB storage limit, which prevented us from including all participant data. As a result, we deposited the dataset on OpenNeuro: https://openneuro.org/datasets/ds007629. OpenNeuro requires the dataset to follow the BIDS format standard. For researchers looking for the preprocessed and synchronized EEG + eye-tracking data with labels (Pickle format), these files are available under: derivatives/synced/ Thank you for your understanding, and please feel free to reach out if you have any questions.
